text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown. Her opponent is 
Shina Frejus, an Umamusume connected to a 
prestigious family. And—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelming the surroundings merely by 
appearing, Mr. C.B. took the stage. The 
crowd placed high expectations upon the 
Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Standing before formidable rivals, 
Katsuragi Ace steeled her resolve to take 
on the challenge. All to win the Satsuki 
Sho as an "Ace"!
